entity.summary: High-performance decentralized trading layer and exchange network extension on Solana offering perpetual futures, spot markets, and lending with verifiable settlement back to Solana.
entity.notes: Current first-party documentation describes Bullet as a Solana network extension purpose-built for high-speed on-chain trading, with perpetual, spot, and lending primitives and settlement posted back to Solana. Current independent metrics report non-zero 24-hour, 7-day, and 30-day perpetual volume and open interest. The team states that members previously built Zeta Markets, but this batch does not assert a formal predecessor, migration, or rebrand relationship without a direct lifecycle statement.
